packageRules.description: Lower bounds in pyproject.toml are raised by hand; Renovate moves uv.lock within them.
Every action in one pull request a week.
Minor, patch and digest updates merge on their own once the required checks pass.
Pinning an action to the commit its tag names today changes no code that runs: no release to let age, and no timestamp to wait on (tests/test_renovate_config.py).
The Python of the image and of the matrix is a decision (tests/test_docker_python.py).
